rule: KEEP only with a UN/OHCHR quote read in full; otherwise CUT. No fatality figures.

claims.claim: Apr 2012 South Sudanese forces seized the Heglig/Panthou oilfield
claims.source: S/PRST/2012/12 (12 Apr 2012), full text in SC/10606
claims.quote: the seizure and occupation of the town of Heglig and its oil fields in Sudan by the SPLA

second_source.quote: Welcoming the withdrawal from Heglig of the army of South Sudan

claims.claim: Heglig is internationally recognised as Sudanese
claims.quote: the town of Heglig and its oil fields in Sudan
claims.note: UN text places Heglig 'in Sudan'; suggest attributing to the Security Council rather than 'internationally recognised'. Keep [CONTESTED] badge.

claims.claim: Heglig housed about half of Sudan's oil output
claims.reason: Neither S/PRST/2012/12 nor S/RES/2046 states an output share; 2046 only mentions 'damage to economic infrastructure, in particular oil installations'.

claims.claim: UN Security Council demanded an end to fighting
claims.quote: The Security Council demands a complete, immediate, and unconditional: end to all fighting; withdrawal of the SPLA from Heglig

claims.claim: Juba 8–11 Jul 2016: SPLA and SPLA-IO forces fought
claims.quote: during and in the aftermath of the fighting between the Sudan People's Liberation Army (SPLA) and the Sudan People's Liberation Movement/Army in Opposition
Riek Machar also fled Juba, and was rumoured to be with his forces, but his exact whereabouts were not known.

out_of_scope.reason: infrastructure/economic claim, not violence or control; not assessed
